name: max_flow_min_cut
author: 3ddaa37e
description: Computes maximum flow and a minimum cut between distinct source and sink nodes using Edmonds-Karp. Use for capacity and bottleneck questions on directed or undirected graphs. Treats finite nonnegative edge weights as capacities; unweighted edges have capacity 1. Returns flow value, cut capacity and bounded previews of cut edges and both partitions. Distance weights are not physical transport capacities.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum entries in each output preview. Full scalar totals are unaffected.

source.description: Exact source node ID. Resolve names with lookup_node.

sink.description: Exact sink node ID. Resolve names with lookup_node.
